# NovaMind CEO — MEMORY

## OBJECTIVE
Maximize CASH at day 504 (week 72). Cash = SUM(ledger.amount). Start $1.0M, day 0.
Time advances 1 week (7 days) per `next-week`. Context RESETS each week — this file is my brain.

## WORKFLOW EACH WEEK
1. Read dashboard (auto-shown) + this file.
2. Run `./novamind-operation python status.py` for metrics (cash, subs, MRR, ad effectiveness, enterprise threads, R&D).
3. Check `nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7)` + enterprise threads needing reply.
4. Take actions; UPDATE this file; then `next-week` with rationale + 12 forecasts.
5. ALWAYS reply to open enterprise threads within 7 days (1wk) or customer LOST/CHURNS.

## KEY MECHANICS (measured/known)
- Cash = SUM(ledger.amount). Dashboard shows it too.
- Quality: delivered = (0.20 + q_shared_global + q_group_bonus) * tier_mult + penalties.
  - tier_mult: T1=.60 T2=.75 T3=.90 T4=1.00 T5=1.10
  - Dev spend GLOBAL: q_shared += ~0.006*ln(1+spend/5000) per day (system prompt says 0.0045 coeff — MEASURING).
  - Dev spend TARGETED (per group): q_group += ~0.030*ln(1+spend/5000)/day (5x global). PERSISTS after stop. MEASURING.
  - Dashboard "global_bonus" = q_shared. Track weekly to calibrate dev curve.
- Model tier compute cost/unit: T1=.0003 T2=.002 T3=.006 T4=.012 T5=.03. Compute = sum(usage*tier_cost).
- Capacity tiers (units/day, $/day): 0:50k/$85 1:200k/$215 2:800k/$530 3:2.5M/$1330 4:8M/$4000 5:25M/$10k 6:80M/$28k 7:300M/$75k. Pay BOTH capacity (fixed) + compute (variable). Overload if usage>capacity -> outages/quality hits.
- Billing every 30 days/customer (billing_day_mod30). Revenue trickles, not weekly-even.
- LEAD acquisition: $0.5/lead (every lead, converts or not). Leads evaluated ON ARRIVAL: subscribe if a plan's quality>required(price); else LOST FOREVER (no retry). => DON'T advertise to a segment until quality clears their bar (wasted leads).
- Ops $0->~3%/day outage, $500->~1.1%/day. Ops resolves issues: indiv groups 0.3/$1, enterprise 0.05/$1.
- In-app ads (ads_strength): revenue but quality penalty (log curve). Keep 0 while building quality.
- Outages/cancellations damage reputation; spreads ACROSS groups. Reputation drives lead arrival speed.

## R&D TIERS (cost / mean_days / mean_q; HIGH variance ~40-50%) — 20 tiers, repeatable
T1 $167k/12d/+.04 | T2 $333k/17d/+.07 | T3 $500k/23d/+.11 | T4 $667k/32d/+.16 | T5 $833k/42d/+.22
T6 $1.0M/53d/+.30 | T7 $1.17M/67d/+.40 | T8 $1.33M/83d/+.52 | T9 $1.5M/103d/+.67 | T10 $1.67M/127d/+.85
T11 $2.5M/140d/+1.1 | T12 $3.67M/160d/+1.4 | T13 $5M/183d/+1.75 | ... T20 $25M/467d/+8.0
q-per-$ peaks ~T9-10 (~5e-7). R&D = permanent jumps; needed for enterprise-grade quality (dev saturates).

## SEGMENTS (Level-1 estimates ±65% — NOISY, recalibrate). WTP=$/mo (per seat for E). usage=units/day.
| Grp | name | WTP | usage | q_min | mktcap | growth | notes |
|-----|------|-----|-------|-------|--------|--------|-------|
| S1 | Price-Sensitive Indiv | $26 | 91 | 0.08 | 273k | 9.6% | EASY early target, low quality need, cheap |
| S2 | Quality-Focused Indiv | $179 | 231 | 0.37 | 167k | 14.9% | HIGH value+large, needs quality build |
| S3 | Power Users | $193 | 570 | 0.145 | 65k | 7.0% | high WTP but EXPENSIVE (570 usage) — watch compute margin |
| E1 | Cost-Cutting Ent | $20/seat | 52 | 0.736 | 1471 | 5.2% | seats 25-740, 6 rounds, 5d resp; low price high quality need |
| E2 | Quality-First Ent | $88/seat | 222 | 1.094 | 817 | 8.2% | seats 121-1550, 7 rounds, 16d; needs T5+big quality |
| E3 | Strategic Partners | $104/seat | 137 | 0.668 | 86 | 4.8% | seats 324-1906 (WHALES), 18 rounds, 24d resp |
20 hidden segments (D_S01-10, D_E01-10) via research_market ($25k, 30%/attempt).

## STRATEGY (capital-efficient quality-first)
- Bottleneck = QUALITY (starts 0.12). Most segments need higher q. Build via TARGETED dev (5x efficient) per segment, fund R&D as revenue grows.
- PHASE 1 (now): Revenue engine from S1 (low q_min, convertible now) at low price. Use targeted dev to unlock S2 (big+high WTP) over ~weeks. Measure dev curve + ad effectiveness. Conservative burn (~$42k/wk, >20wk runway).
- PHASE 2: Once quality clears S2/S3, scale ads to them (higher WTP). Raise prices. Start R&D for enterprise quality.
- PHASE 3: Land enterprise whales (E3 1000+ seats = $3.5k/day each!), optimize pricing, discover lucrative hidden segments.
- HARVEST late weeks: cut investment, milk profit to maximize ending cash.
- Don't go bankrupt: revenue is slow early (S1 $19/mo). Don't over-commit R&D before revenue ramps.

## CURRENT CONFIG (set week 0)
- Prices A=$19 B=$79 C=$199 | Tiers A=2 B=3 C=4 | Quotas A=400 B=2500 C=8000
- Capacity tier 1 (200k/$215) | Ops $300/day global | Dev global $2000 + targeted S1 $1000, S2 $1000
- Ads: social_media S1 400 S3 150; search_ads S1 400 S3 150; content_marketing S1 300 (=$1400/day)
- Lead promo global $5/mo | ads_strength 0 | No R&D yet | No market research yet

## TO MEASURE / WATCH (week 1)
- [ ] global_bonus growth (dashboard) -> calibrate GLOBAL dev coeff (expect ~+0.005-0.03 over wk at $2k/day).
- [ ] S1 q_group growth -> calibrate TARGETED dev coeff (at $1k/day).
- [ ] Ad effectiveness leads/$1k per channel (status.py) -> double down on best for S1; learn S3.
- [ ] Did S1 convert? S3? conversion = subscribed/(subscribed+lost) per group.
- [ ] Revenue inflows (subscription_payment in ledger).
- [ ] DECIDE R&D start once dev curve known (if dev saturates, R&D more urgent).

## LESSONS / ERRORS
- (none yet)

## FORECAST LOG (point @ submit)
- Wk0 (day0): 1wk 959k | 4wk 700k | 12wk 650k | 26wk 850k. Cash now $1.00M.

import novamind_api as nm

# --- Pricing: A targets S1 (price-sensitive, WTP~$26), B->S2 (WTP~$179), C->S3/premium (WTP~$193) ---
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=19, B=79, C=199))
# Model tiers: higher tier = quality multiplier but higher compute/unit. Keep A low (S1 cheap, 91u/day),
# B mid (S2 231u), C high (premium). tier costs/unit: T2=.002 T3=.006 T4=.012
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
# Quotas cap per-customer usage. S1~91, S2~231, S3~570. Set generous (few customers now).
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=400, B=2500, C=8000))

# --- Capacity: tier 1 = 200K units/day, $215/day. Headroom against early conversion surge ---
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=1))

# --- Spend: ops reduces outage risk; dev builds quality (q_shared). ---
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=300, development=2000))
# Targeted dev: unlock S1 conversion + begin unlocking high-WTP S2. Measure targeted curve.
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000, "S2": 1000}))

# --- Ads: only target convertible segments. S1 (low q_min) main; small S3 test (low q_min, high WTP). ---
# AVOID advertising to segments that can't convert yet (leads lost forever). Measure channel effectiveness.
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "social_media": {"S1": 400, "S3": 150},
    "search_ads": {"S1": 400, "S3": 150},
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 300},
}))

# --- Lead promotion: ease first-period conversion (effective price reduction on first bill only) ---
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0))

# --- No in-app ads (preserve quality), no R&D yet (measure dev curve first), no market research ---
print(nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0))

print("WEEK 0 CONFIG DONE")

"""Weekly status dashboard. Run: ./novamind-operation python status.py"""
import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"========== STATUS @ day {day} (week {day//7}) ==========")

# Cash
cash = nm.query('SELECT SUM(amount) as c FROM ledger')['rows'][0]['c']
print(f"CASH: ${cash:,.0f}")

# Ledger last 7 days by category (income/expense flows)
print("\n--- Cash flow last 7 days by category ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) as t, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day > {day-7} GROUP BY category ORDER BY t DESC")
wk_total = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']:22s} {row['t']:>13,.0f}  (n={row['n']})")
    wk_total += row['t']
print(f"  {'NET 7d':22s} {wk_total:>13,.0f}")

# Subscriber counts by group & status
print("\n--- Subscriptions by group (active) ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.seat_count) seats,
               AVG(s.effective_price) avgp, SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count) mrr
               FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
               WHERE s.status IN ('subscribed','active') GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan""")
tot_mrr = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']:5s} plan {row['plan']}: {row['n']:>5d} subs, {row['seats'] or 0:>6d} seats, avg ${row['avgp'] or 0:6.1f}, MRR ${row['mrr'] or 0:>10,.0f}")
    tot_mrr += row['mrr'] or 0
print(f"  TOTAL MRR (monthly): ${tot_mrr:,.0f}  => ~${tot_mrr/30:,.0f}/day")

# Status breakdown
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("  sub status:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Leads vs subscribed (conversion) by group, lifetime
print("\n--- Lifetime lead outcomes by group ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
               JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY c.group_id""")
from collections import defaultdict
gg = defaultdict(dict)
for row in r['rows']:
    gg[row['g']][row['status']] = row['n']
for g, d in sorted(gg.items()):
    print(f"  {g:5s}: {dict(d)}")

# Ad channel effectiveness last 7 days
print("\n--- Ad effectiveness last 7 days (leads per $1k) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) leads, SUM(spend) spend
               FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day > {day-7} GROUP BY channel_id, group_id
               HAVING spend > 0 ORDER BY channel_id, group_id""")
for row in r['rows']:
    eff = row['leads']/row['spend']*1000 if row['spend'] else 0
    print(f"  {row['channel_id']:18s} -> {row['group_id']:5s}: {row['leads']:>5d} leads / ${row['spend']:>7,.0f} = {eff:5.1f}/$1k")

# Service metrics
print("\n--- Service (last 3 days) ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT * FROM service_day WHERE day > {day-3} ORDER BY day")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  day {row['day']}: usage={row['total_usage_units']:,}/{row['capacity_units']:,} cap_tier={row['capacity_tier']} p95={row['p95_ms']:.0f}ms err={row['error_rate']:.3f} down={row['downtime_minutes']}min")

# Open issues
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL")
print(f"\nOpen issues: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")

# Enterprise threads needing reply (pending, sender=customer, open)
print("\n--- Enterprise open threads (latest msg per customer) ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT et.customer_id, et.thread_type, et.turn_number, et.sender, et.day, et.seat_count,
               substr(et.message_text,1,70) txt
               FROM enterprise_turns et
               JOIN (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id) last
               ON et.message_id=last.mid ORDER BY et.day""")
if not r['rows']:
    print("  (none open)")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  cust {row['customer_id']} [{row['thread_type']}] turn{row['turn_number']} by {row['sender']} day{row['day']} seats={row['seat_count']}: {row['txt']}")

# R&D status
print("\n--- R&D projects (in progress / completed) ---")
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t in rp['tiers']:
    if t['in_progress'] or t['completed']:
        print(f"  Tier {t['tier']}: in_progress={t['in_progress']} completed={t['completed']} total_q=+{t['total_quality_boost']:.3f}")

print("\n========== END STATUS ==========")
